name: Jotego Beta Key
description: Downloads Jotego's jtbeta.zip and extracts the beta key into Licenses/ so the beta cores can be installed. Fetches from the JTFPGA/jtbeta GitHub repo (needs a GitHub token with sponsor access) and/or from Jotego's Patreon (needs your Patreon session cookie). Asks for the source and credentials once and keeps them on the SD card in Plugins/jotego-beta-key/config.json. A jtbeta.zip or beta.bin you put in the root of the card is used instead and nothing is downloaded. in pupdate, run before cores on every Update All.
